title: The Vanishing Village of Kuldhara
hook: In a single night in 1825, an entire ancient village vanished into thin air, leaving behind intact homes, personal belongings, and a terrifying curse that lingers to this day.

scenes.narration: Deep in the scorched deserts of Rajasthan lies Kuldhara, a ghost village frozen in time. Once home to over fifteen hundred prosperous villagers, it now stands utterly desolate.
scenes.visual_prompt: Cinematic wide shot of ruined sandstone houses in a barren desert landscape, golden hour sunlight casting eerie long shadows.

scenes.narration: On a quiet night in 1825, all eight hundred residents from Kuldhara and eighty-two surrounding villages vanished. No one saw them leave. No one knew where they went.
scenes.visual_prompt: Eerie nighttime shot of empty sandstone archways, dusty wind blowing through abandoned doorways, flickering lanterns.

scenes.narration: Legend says a tyrannical state minister demanded the village chief's daughter. Rather than submit, the villagers chose to abandon their ancestral home overnight, casting a dark hex: anyone who tries to inhabit Kuldhara will perish.
scenes.visual_prompt: Close-up of ancient, cracked clay pots and abandoned household items gathering dust in a dark room.

scenes.narration: Modern paranormal investigators report strange moving shadows, sudden drops in temperature, and unexplainable footsteps in the night. To this day, Kuldhara remains completely uninhabited.
scenes.visual_prompt: Slow zoom-out of the desolate village ruins under a starry, ominous night sky with atmospheric fog.
